spells.guide: Immensely increases the speed of projectile spells.
spells.name: Accelerate III

spells.guide: Greatly increases the speed of projectile spells.
spells.name: Accelerate II

spells.guide: Massively increases the power of most spell effects.
spells.name: Amplify III

spells.guide: Greatly increases the power of most spell effects.
spells.name: Amplify II

spells.guide: Spells will affect a gargantuan area around a targeted block.
spells.name: AOE III

spells.guide: Spells will affect a huge area around a targeted block.
spells.name: AOE II

spells.guide: Massively decreases the power of most spells.
spells.name: Dampen III

spells.guide: Greatly decreases the power of most spells.
spells.name: Dampen II

spells.guide: Massively reduces the duration of spells
spells.name: Duration Down III

spells.guide: Greatly reduces the duration of spells.
spells.name: Duration Down II

spells.guide: Conjures the void itself to destroy blocks without creating items and deal damage capable of bypassing most defenses.
spells.name: Annihilate

spells.guide: Creates a bonfire that burns anything in contact.
spells.name: Cremation

spells.guide: Conjures an arrow propelled towards a target. Split will increase how many arrows are created.
spells.name: Conjure Arrow

spells.guide: Conjures a weapon propelled towards a target. If a weapon is held a replica of that weapon will be created for this spell. Split will increase how many blades are created, AoE will greatly increase how many blades are created but also increases the distance between blades. Randomize will randomly select any weapons from the casters inventory.
spells.name: Conjure Blade

spells.guide: Shreds the target with invisible blades. Augment with accelerate to lower the i-frames after each attack.
spells.name: Dismantle

spells.guide: Upgraded version of lightning that deals increased damage by consuming levels of 'shocked'
spells.name: Divine Smite

spells.guide: Creates a Sphereical area that applies spells on nearby entities for a short time. Applying Sensitive will make this spell target blocks instead. AOE will expand the effective range, Accelerate will cast spells faster, Dampen will cause the domain to be affected by gravity, and Extend Time will increase the duration. After casting a spell with Domain the caster will be effected by Domain burnout and will be unable to cast another domain.
spells.name: Domain

spells.guide: Inflicts the target with Eruption. Entities with this effect take highly increased damage when burning.
spells.name: Eruption

spells.guide: Inflicts the target with Fracture. Entities with this effect take damage when they make impact with blocks.
spells.name: Fracture

spells.guide: When the spell resolves on an ice block Iceburst will shatter the block and damage nearby entities.
spells.name: Iceburst

spells.guide: Sets the velocity of entities in an area to 0 (includes spell projectiles and other entities not normally target-able). Applying AOE will increase the radius this effect is applied. Augmenting with Amplify will multiply the velocity by: -X/3. Augmenting with Dampen will multiply the velocity by: -1. Augmenting with Sensitive allows the caster to be affected by limitless.
spells.name: Limitless

spells.guide: Summons a meteor that falls at the spot where the spell is resolved. The meteor propagates the rest of the spell upon crashing. The greater the height the meteor falls from the remaining spell will have amplify augments added.
spells.name: Meteor Swarm

spells.guide: Raises a pillar of earth, pushing away any nearby entities. Can be augmented with AOE, pierce, and amplify. (Credit to ArsOmega)
spells.name: Raise Earth

spells.guide: Grants a simple domain that protects against the surehit of domains.
spells.name: Simple Domain

spells.guide: Inflicts the target with Soul Rime. Entities with this effect cannot teleport.
spells.name: Soul Rime

spells.guide: Summons a number of Skeleton allies that will attack nearby hostile enemies. These Skeletons will last a short time until they begin to take damage, but time may be extended with the Extend Time augment.  Additionally, their summoned weapons are changed using augments, use Amplify to give it a better sword, or Pierce to give it a bow.  Adding Split after the effect will add to the number of summoned skeletons.
spells.name: Summon Undead

spells.guide: Swaps the roles of the caster and target, allowing for more complex logic. (Credit to ArsOmega)
spells.name: Swap Target

spells.guide: Summons forth various shikigami from the well's unknown abyss. Additional shikigami can be tamed through a ritual.
spells.name: Ten Shadows

spells.guide: Immensely extends the time that spells last.
spells.name: Extend Time III

spells.guide: Greatly extends the time that spells last.
spells.name: Extend Time II

spells.guide: Ends spell if it attempts to target the caster.
spells.name: Filter: Not Self

spells.guide: Spells will affect a decreased area.
spells.name: Lesser AOE

spells.guide: Summons a projectile that applies spell effects when this projectile hits a target or block. The projectile will resolve in the air after traveling for a set time. This time can be altered with extend time. Pierce will cause this time to reset on spell resolve.
spells.name: Detonate

spells.guide: Alters the Domain effect to target the world itself
spells.name: Open Barrier

spells.guide: Summons a projectile that applies spell effects when this projectile hits a target or block. The projectile will resolve in the air after traveling for a set time. This time can be altered with extend time. Pierce will cause this time to reset on spell resolve.
spells.name: Detonate

spells.guide: Uses a glyph slot to reduce the mana cost of a spell. New Cost = Old Cost * 0.7 ^ X. Mana regeneration speed is temporarily exhausted after use.
spells.name: Spell Efficiency

spells.guide: Marks the target and stores the mark in a Reliquary.
spells.name: Mark

spells.guide: Recalls the target stored in a Reliquary and casts the spell on it.
spells.name: Recall

spells.guide: Applies spells to the last entity that dealt damage to you. The damage must be within the last 5 seconds.
spells.name: Retaliate

spells.guide: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets an aerial creature.
spells.name: Filter:Aerial

spells.guide: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets an aquatic creature.
spells.name: Filter:Aquatic

spells.guide: This projectile is affected by gravity. Every Pierce applied will make it bounce one time when it hit the ground.
spells.name: Arc Projectile

spells.guide: Creates a protective coating that consumes mana to reduce incoming damage. The shield might also prevent debuff to affect the entity and will dissipate if the mana exhausts while defending. The bubble will also shield from magic fire.
spells.name: Bubble Shield

spells.guide: Try to dominate the mind of enemy, making them fight for you as a temporary ally, a tamable mob, to tame it, or a wild animal, to make it fall in love. Each Amplify and damage dealt raises the chance of successfully charming the target, as stronger mobs will have higher resistance to your control.
spells.name: Charm

spells.guide: Places terrain block at a location. Can place more blocks if augmented with AoE or Pierce
spells.name: Conjure Terrain

spells.guide: Discharge an entity affected by static charge or shocked, damaging it and shocking surrounding enemies. If the damage was triggered by static charge, it will be empowered. If the main target had energy-based armors, some of the energy in it will be absorbed to boost damage.
spells.name: Discharge

spells.guide: Poisons the target, dealing damage over time. If the target is already poisoned, the poison will become a more deadly venom. An envenomed target takes more damage from poison spores.
spells.name: Envenom

spells.guide: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets a fire immune or fiery creature.
spells.name: Filter:Fiery

spells.guide: This projectile seek the nearest entity and follow it, will behave as a classic projectile while there are no valid targets. Players will only be targeted if augmented by Sensitive.
spells.name: Homing Projectile

spells.guide: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets an arthropod creature.
spells.name: Filter:Insect

spells.guide: You create a link between your life force and the target's. Any damage dealt to you will be shared with the target and any healing of the target will be shared with you. Cut can sever the life link, ending the effect on both sides.
spells.name: Life Link

spells.guide: Stops the spell from resolving if it targets an aerial creature.
spells.name: Filter:Not Aerial

spells.guide: Stops the spell from resolving if it targets an aquatic creature.
spells.name: Filter:Not Aquatic

spells.guide: Stops the spell from resolving if it targets a fire immune or fiery creature.
spells.name: Filter:Not Fiery

spells.guide: Stops the spell from resolving if it targets an arthropod creature.
spells.name: Filter:Not Insect

spells.guide: Stops the spell from resolving if it targets a summoned creature.
spells.name: Filter:Not Summon

spells.guide: Stops the spell from resolving if it targets an undead creature.
spells.name: Filter:Not Undead

spells.guide: Heals a small amount of health to undead. When used on living beings, the spell will deal an equal amount of magic damage and consume hunger.
spells.name: Phantom Grasp

spells.guide: A fog of poison spores erupts from the target, damaging it and causing poison and hunger to spread to nearby entities. It can only damage mobs poisoned or afflicted by hunger.
spells.name: Spores

spells.guide: Convert the remainder of the spell into an Arc Projectile and shoot it from where it lands.
spells.name: Propagate Arc

spells.guide: Convert the remainder of the spell into an Homing Projectile and shoot it from where it lands.
spells.name: Propagate Homing

spells.guide: Damages the target with a spark of static energy and shocks it. Deals more damage to wet entities
spells.name: Spark

spells.guide: Creates a spike of dripstone that will damage entities that touch it. Can be augmented with AoE and Pierce to make it wider or taller, with ExtendTime to make it last longer or with Amplify to make it deal more damage.
spells.name: Spike

spells.guide: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets a summoned creature.
spells.name: Filter:Summon

spells.guide: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets an undead creature.
spells.name: Filter:Undead

spells.guide: Causes entities to drown. When augmented with Extend Time, they will be dragged down and unable to swim up.
spells.name: Watery Grave

spells.guide: Resolves the spell in a spherical area around the target. Augment with Sensitive to target blocks instead of entities and Dampen to make an empty sphere. Augment with AOE to increase the radius.
spells.name: Burst

spells.guide: Increases the speed of projectile spells.
spells.name: Accelerate

spells.guide: Additively increases the power of most spell effects. Can increase the harvest level of Break and increases the damage of spells.
spells.name: Amplify

spells.guide: Animates a block to fight for you. The animated block will convert to a falling block when it dies. Costs a large amount of mana, but does not grant Summoning Sickness
spells.name: Animate Block

spells.guide: Spells will affect a larger area around a targeted block.
spells.name: AOE

spells.guide: Teleports the caster to a location. If an entity is hit and the caster is holding a Warp Scroll in the offhand, the entity will be warped to the location on the Warp Scroll. When used on Self, the caster blinks forward. Spell Turrets and Runes can warp entities using Warp Scrolls from adjacent inventories without consuming the scroll.
spells.name: Blink

spells.guide: Gives players the Bounce effect, causing them to bounce upwards upon falling. Amplification of Bounce will preserve additional forward facing motion per bounce.
spells.name: Bounce

spells.guide: A spell you start with. Breaks blocks of an average hardness. Can be amplified to increase the harvest level. Sensitive will simulate breaking blocks with Shears instead of a pickaxe.
spells.name: Break

spells.guide: Causes wet, slowed, or freezing entities to take a burst of damage and erupt into falling ice. Falling ice will slow and damage nearby entities. Can also be used to erupt a block of ice instead. Falling blocks of ice can be manipulated with the Focus of Block Shaping. Entities afflicted with Freezing will be set to the maximum freeze level immediately.
spells.name: Cold Snap

spells.guide: Places water at a location or extinguishes entities on fire. If augmented with extend time, it will keep entities wet for a longer period of time.
spells.name: Conjure Water

spells.guide: Opens the crafting menu.
spells.name: Craft

spells.guide: Turns stone into gravel, and gravel into sand. Will also crush flowers into bonus dye. Need Sensitive to work on items. For full recipe support, see JEI. Will also harm entities and deals bonus damage to entities that are swimming.
spells.name: Crush

spells.guide: Simulates using shears on entities and blocks, or damages non-shearable entities for a small amount. Amplify will simulate using an Axe instead of Shears. For simulating breaking with shears, see Break and Sensitive. Costs nothing.
spells.name: Cut

spells.guide: Decreases the power of most spells.
spells.name: Dampen

spells.guide: Decreases the speed of projectile spells.
spells.name: Decelerate

spells.guide: Delays the resolution of effects placed to the right of this spell for a few moments. The delay may be increased with the Extend Time augment, or decreased with Duration Down.
spells.name: Delay

spells.guide: Removes any potion effects on the target. When used on a witch at half health, the witch will vanish in return for a Wixie shard. Will also dispel tamed summons back into their charm.
spells.name: Dispel

spells.guide: Reduces the duration of spells like potion effects, delay, redstone signal, and others.
spells.name: Duration Down

spells.guide: Opens your personal ender chest inventory from anywhere.
spells.name: Access Ender Inventory

spells.guide: Deletes fluids in an area. Can be expanded with AOE.
spells.name: Evaporate

spells.guide: When used on blocks, exchanges the blocks in the players hotbar for the blocks hit as if they were mined with silk touch. Can be augmented with AOE, and Amplify is required for swapping blocks of higher hardness. When used on entities, the locations of the caster and the entity hit are swapped.
spells.name: Exchange

spells.guide: Causes an explosion at the location. Amplify increases the damage and size by a small amount, while AOE will increase the size of the explosion by a large amount, but not damage.
spells.name: Explosion

spells.guide: Extends the time that spells last, including buffs, fangs, and summons
spells.name: Extend Time

spells.guide: Applies a silk-touch effect to Break and causes Explosion to not destroy blocks that drop. Cannot be combined with Fortune.
spells.name: Extract

spells.guide: Summons Evoker Fangs in the direction where the spell was targeted. Using fangs on your self will spawn them in an area around you.
spells.name: Fangs

spells.guide: Harvests entire trees, mushrooms, cactus, and other vegetation. Can be amplified with Amplify to break materials of higher hardness. AOE will increase the number of blocks that may be broken at one time.
spells.name: Fell

spells.guide: Creates a firework at the location or entity. Amplify will add Firework Stars, while Extend Time will add additional flight time. If a firework exists in the casters inventory, the created firework will mimic the held one. Spell Turrets with Touch will create fireworks as if they were dispensed.
spells.name: Firework

spells.guide: When used on an entity or block that is on fire or afflicted with Blasting, Cinders will explode around the target, dealing damage and creating Mage Fire nearby. Mage Fire cannot spread to blocks and is short lived. Entities with Blasting will immediately explode for extra strength.
spells.name: Flare

spells.guide: Increases the drop chance from mobs killed by Damage and blocks that are destroyed by Break. Cannot be combined with Extract.
spells.name: Luck

spells.guide: Freezes water or lava in a small area or slows a target for a short time. Freeze on Ice will turn it into Packed Ice, and Packed Ice into Blue Ice. Sensitive will turn water into Frosted Ice and will vanish after a short time.
spells.name: Freeze

spells.guide: Grants the Glide effect, allowing the wearer to fly as if they were wearing an Elytra.
spells.name: Glide

spells.guide: Causes blocks and entities to fall. When augmented with Extend Time, players will have their flight disabled and will obtain the Gravity effect. While afflicted with Gravity, entities will rapidly fall and take double falling damage.
spells.name: Gravity

spells.guide: Causes plants to accelerate in growth as if they were bonemealed.
spells.name: Grow

spells.guide: Knocks a target or block away a short distance from the caster. Sensitive will stop this spell from launching blocks.
spells.name: Knockback

spells.guide: A spell you start with. Damages a target. May be increased by Amplify, or applies the Poison debuff when using Extend Time. Note, multiple Harms without a delay will not apply due to invincibility on hit.
spells.name: Harm

spells.guide: When used on grown crops, this spell will obtain the fully grown product without destroying the plant.
spells.name: Harvest

spells.guide: Heals a small amount of health and consumes hunger from the caster. When used on Undead, the spell will deal an equal amount of magic damage.
spells.name: Heal

spells.guide: Applies the Hex effect. Hex increases any damage taken by a small amount while the user is afflicted by poison, wither, fire, or when frozen. Additionally, Hex cuts the rate of Mana Regeneration and healing in half.
spells.name: Hex

spells.guide: Sets blocks and mobs on fire for a short time. Sensitive will summon Mage Fire, a shorter lived fire that will not spread or destroy blocks.
spells.name: Ignite

spells.guide: Infuses a target with a potion or flask from your inventory. If augmented with AOE, a splash potion will spawn at the location. If augmented with Extend Time, a lingering potion will spawn at the location. Caster blocks may pull from adjacent Potion Jars to cast infuse.
spells.name: Infuse

spells.guide: Causes blocks to temporarily turn into air. Can be modified with Amplify for blocks of higher hardness, AOE, Duration Down, and Extend Time.
spells.name: Intangible

spells.guide: Interacts with blocks or entities as it were a player. Useful for reaching levers, chests, or animals. Sensitive will use your off-hand item on the block or entity.
spells.name: Interact

spells.guide: Causes the target to turn invisible for a short time.
spells.name: Invisibility

spells.guide: Launches an entity or block into the air. Can be used for large jumps, yeeting mobs in the sky or for scaling mountains! Sensitive will stop this spell from launching blocks.
spells.name: Launch

spells.guide: Launches the target in the direction they are looking. Amplification will increase the distance moved.
spells.name: Leap

spells.guide: If cast on a block, a permanent light source is created. May be amplified up to Glowstone brightness, or Dampened for a lower light level. When cast on yourself, you will receive night vision. When cast on other entities, they will receive Night Vision and Glowing.
spells.name: Conjure Magelight

spells.guide: Summons a lightning bolt at the location. Entities struck will be given the Shocked effect. Shocked causes all additional lightning damage to deal bonus damage, and increases the level of Shocked up to III. Lightning also deals bonus damage to entities that are wet or wearing RF powered items. Can be augmented with Amplify, Dampen, and Extend Time.
spells.name: Lightning

spells.guide: Creates a lingering field that applies spells on nearby entities for a short time. Applying Sensitive will make this spell target blocks instead. AOE will expand the effective range, Accelerate will cast spells faster, Dampen will ignore gravity, and Extend Time will increase the duration.
spells.name: Linger

spells.guide: Names an entity after the set Spell Name. Targeting a block will name nearby entities or name inventory blocks directly if possible. Targeting with Self will name the held offhand item. Can be overridden with a name tag in the hotbar.
spells.name: Name

spells.guide: Summons three orbiting projectiles around the target that will cast a spell on any entities it may hit. Additional projectiles, their speed, radius, and duration may be augmented. Sensitive will cause Orbit to hit blocks.
spells.name: Orbit

spells.guide: Creates a temporary block that will disappear after a short time. Amplify will cause the block to be permanent. Dispelling this block will destroy it instantly.
spells.name: Conjure Mageblock

spells.guide: Picks up nearby items in a medium radius where this spell is activated. The range may be expanded with AOE.
spells.name: Item Pickup

spells.guide: When applied to the Projectile spell, projectiles may continue through their path an additional time after hitting a mob or block. Causes certain effects to also target the block behind them, like Break. Combines with AOE to provide depth.
spells.name: Pierce

spells.guide: Places blocks from the casters inventory. If a player is casting this, this spell will place blocks from the hot bar first.
spells.name: Place Block

spells.guide: A spell you start with. Summons a projectile that applies spell effects when this projectile hits a target or block. Sensitive will allow Projectiles to break plants or other materials that do not block motion.
spells.name: Projectile

spells.guide: Pulls the target closer to the caster. When used on blocks, they become falling blocks with motion towards the side of the block that was hit. Sensitive will stop this spell from pulling blocks.
spells.name: Pull

spells.guide: Randomize the behavior of some glyphs. If used with spells like Place Block and Exchange, it will randomize the block that is placed between the blocks in your hotbar.
spells.name: Randomize

spells.guide: Places a temporary block of redstone with configurable power and duration. Augment with Sensitive to set the target block as a power source for itself and surrounding blocks. Dampen and Amplify will adjust the power from the base value of 10.
spells.name: Redstone Signal

spells.guide: Rotates a block or an entity clockwise. If augmented with sensitive it will change the axis of the block (if possible) or force the entity to turn their look. Dampen will rotate counter-clockwise.
spells.name: Rotate

spells.guide: Places a rune on the ground that will cast the spell on targets that touch the rune. Unlike runes placed by Runic Chalk, these runes are temporary and cannot be recharged. When using Item Pickup, items are deposited into adjacent inventories. Sensitive will cause the rune to use the Owner's inventory for pickup and usage instead. Players with Magic Find will be able to read spells inscribed on runes.
spells.name: Rune

spells.guide: A spell you start with. Applies spells on the caster.
spells.name: Self

spells.guide: Applies Magic Find to the target, causing magical mobs to glow within 75 blocks of them. Magic Find also reveals spells on Runes.
spells.name: Sense Magic

spells.guide: Causes forms to target blocks they normally cannot target. Projectile and Orbit will target grass, and Touch will target fluids and air. Changes targeting rules of certain effects.
spells.name: Sensitive

spells.guide: Applies the Slow Fall buff.
spells.name: Slowfall

spells.guide: Smelts blocks and items in the world. AOE will increase the number of items and radius of blocks that can be smelted at once, while Amplify will allow Smelt to work on blocks of higher hardness, Sensitive will make it only smelt items and not blocks.
spells.name: Smelt

spells.guide: Stops entities from moving and jumping. Extend Time will increase the duration of this effect. Snaring a block created from the Focus of Block Shaping will cause it to attempt to place itself immediately.
spells.name: Snare

spells.guide: Causes multiple projectiles to be cast at once. Each projectile applies a set of effects.
spells.name: Split

spells.guide: Summons a decoy of yourself. Upon summoning, the decoy will attract any nearby mobs to attack it.
spells.name: Summon Decoy

spells.guide: Summons a saddled horse that will vanish after a few minutes. AOE will increase the amount summoned, while Extend Time will increase the duration of the summon. Applies Summoning Sickness to the caster, and cannot be cast while afflicted by this Sickness.
spells.name: Summon Steed

spells.guide: Summons a number of Skeleton allies that will attack nearby hostile enemies. These Skeletons will last a short time until they begin to take damage, but time may be extended with the Extend Time augment.  Additionally, their summoned weapons are changed using augments, use Amplify to give it a better sword, or Pierce to give it a bow.  Adding Split after the effect will add to the number of summoned skeletons.
spells.name: Summon Undead

spells.guide: Summons three Vex allies that will attack nearby hostile enemies. These Vex will last a short time until they begin to take damage, but time may be extended with the Extend Time augment.
spells.name: Summon Vex

spells.guide: Summons two wolves that will fight with you. Extend Time will increase the amount of time on the summons. Applies Summoning Sickness to the caster, preventing other summoning magic.
spells.name: Summon Wolves

spells.guide: Causes the caster to place an item from their inventory to a location. If this glyph is used on an inventory, the item will attempt to be inserted into it. Toss throws 64 items by default. Dampen will halve the amount each time. Amplify will double the amount each time. Randomize will select a random stack.
spells.name: Toss

spells.guide: Applies spells at the block or entity that is targeted.
spells.name: Touch

spells.guide: Targets the spell on the block beneath the player.
spells.name: Underfoot

spells.guide: Creates a lingering wall that applies spells on nearby entities for a short time. Applying Sensitive will make this spell target blocks instead. AOE will expand the effective range, Accelerate will cast spells faster, Dampen will ignore gravity, and Extend Time will increase the duration.
spells.name: Wall

spells.guide: Deals damage to targets in the air, with an increasing amount based on how high the target is off the ground, up to 10 blocks. Targets on the ground take no damage.
spells.name: Wind Shear

spells.guide: Applies the Wither debuff.
spells.name: Wither

spells.guide: Resets the spell chain to the original target if it was changed by a previous effect. For example, Burst -> Place Block -> Reset -> Break will cause Burst to place blocks, but only Break will apply to the original location. As a result, using Reset will allow you to bypass combination and duplicate limits on glyphs.
spells.name: Reset

spells.guide: Rewinds an entity back in time to its previous locations and health. Can revert blocks that were moved with spells back into solid blocks. Glyphs that come after Rewind will be cast at the end of the rewind, as if they were Delayed.
spells.name: Rewind

spells.guide: Changes the color of an entity or compatible block to the color of the spell.
spells.name: Wololo

spells.guide: Flattens the target against the block below them, doing damage based on the hardness. If used on blocks it will simulate the use of a shovel on it.
spells.name: Flatten

spells.guide: Convert the remainder of the spell into a Projectile spell and shoot it from where it resolves.
spells.name: Propagate Projectile

spells.guide: Resolves the remainder of the spell on the caster.
spells.name: Propagate Self

spells.guide: Resolves the remainder of the spell one block under the position hit.
spells.name: Propagate Underfoot

spells.guide: Simulate the use of an Hoe on blocks.
spells.name: Plow

spells.guide: Resolves the remainder of the spell into a plane, extending from the block hit. Add Sensitive to make the plane circular. Add Dampen to make the plane hollow.
spells.name: Propagate Plane

spells.guide: Fire a projectile that resolves the spell multiple times on its trail. Add Sensitive to make it resolve on blocks. Use extend time to reduce the delay between each cast and AoE to increase the area of effect.
spells.name: Trail

spells.guide: Consume Demon Will and attack your target (damage scales with will in inventory). Target drops Raw will on kill. $(br2)Extend Time applies potion effect based on Will type. $(br2)Raw - Poison $(br)Corrosive - Withering $(br)Vengeful - Weakness $(br)Steadfast - Slowness $(br)Destructive - Vulnerable
spells.name: Sentient Harm

spells.guide: Marks a target on first hit. Attacking a marked target will do a scaling heavy attack in a radius and Marks all targets. Consumes Will. $(br2)Grants player bonuses on kill when not using Raw will.$(br2)Corrosive - Resistance$(br)Vengeful - Speed$(br)Steadfast - Absorption$(br)Destructive - Spell Power
spells.name: Sentient Wrath

spells.guide: Causes a spell to chain through multiple grouped targets, either similar blocks or living entities other than the caster. AOE increases target count. Pierce increases maximum jump distance between targets.
spells.name: Chaining

spells.guide: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets a farm animal.
spells.name: Filter: Animal

spells.guide: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets a block.
spells.name: Filter: Block

spells.guide: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets an entity.
spells.name: Filter: Entity

spells.guide: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets an immature, ageable living creature.
spells.name: Filter: Baby

spells.guide: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets a mature, ageable living creature.
spells.name: Filter: Mature

spells.guide: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets a loose item in the world. Likely useless on Projectile and basic Ray, which cannot target non-living entities.
spells.name: Filter: Item

spells.guide: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets a living entity.
spells.name: Filter: Living

spells.guide: Stops the spell from resolving if it targets a monster.
spells.name: Filter: Not Monster

spells.guide: Stops the spell from resolving if it targets a player.
spells.name: Filter: Not Player

spells.guide: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets a monster.
spells.name: Filter: Monster

spells.guide: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets a player.
spells.name: Filter: Player

spells.guide: Instantaneously strikes the pointed-at target, at limited yet greater range than Touch. Mana is expended whether or not the ray hits anything. AOE increases range. Sensitive 1 lets the ray strike objects that do not block motion, such as plants or floating Magelight globes. Sensitive 2 allows the ray to strike fluids.
spells.name: Ray

spells.guide: Reverses the direction of a block-targeted spell across the face struck.
spells.name: Reverse Direction
